title: Skill practice — Sepsis recognition (Med-Surg)
disclaimer: All patients, orders, and events in this pack are fictional and for educational practice only.
learningObjectives: Recognize sepsis red flags after infection (confusion, fever, tachycardia, hypotension)
Perform Q4H sepsis screens with VS, body-system, and lab rundowns
Use the sepsis/shock/MODS cheat guide and start the hour-1 bundle when criteria are met
Escalate promptly with rapid assessment and provider notification
